title: Checks for usage of as conversions.
summary: as conversions will perform many kinds of conversions, including silently lossy conversions and dangerous coercions. There are cases when it makes sense to use as, so the lint is Allow by default. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for the usage of as *const _ or as *mut _ conversion using inferred type.
summary: The conversion might include a dangerous cast that might go undetected due to the type being inferred. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for the result of a &self-taking as_ptr being cast to a mutable pointer.
summary: Since as_ptr takes a &self, the pointer won’t have write permissions unless interior mutability is used, making it unlikely that having it as a mutable pointer is correct. Clippy puts this lint in the nursery group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for the usage of as _ conversion using inferred type.
summary: The conversion might include lossy conversion or a dangerous cast that might go undetected due to the type being inferred. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks assertions that only test whether a supported value is empty.
summary: A boolean assertion only reports that the emptiness check failed. It does not show what the asserted value contained. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for assert!(true) and assert!(false) calls.
summary: Will be optimized out by the compiler or should probably be replaced by a panic!() or unreachable!() Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for assert!(r.is_ok()) or assert!(r.is_err()) calls.
summary: This form of assertion does not show any of the information present in the Result other than which variant it isn’t. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for a = a op b or a = b commutative_op a patterns.
summary: These can be written as the shorter a op= b. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Nothing.
summary: This lint has been deprecated Clippy puts this lint in the deprecated group, at the level none.

title: Checks for code like foo = bar.clone();
summary: Custom Clone::clone_from() or ToOwned::clone_into implementations allow the objects to share resources and therefore avoid allocations. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for async blocks that yield values of types that can themselves be awaited.
summary: An await is likely missing. Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.
